title: 외국군인ㆍ군속에 대한 명예계급 수여 규정 / queue:ANNEX:0000:00:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
ATTACHED FORM ? CERTIFICATE OF CONFERMENT OF HONORARY MILITARY RANK
<Amended on December 17, 2013>

CERTIFICATE OF CONFERMENT OF HONORARY MILITARY RANK

Affiliation: __________________________________________
Name: ______________________________________________
Date of birth: ______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

Pursuant to Article 2 of the Regulations on the Conferment of Honorary Military Ranks upon Foreign Military Personnel and Civilian Personnel Attached to Foreign Armed Forces, the honorary rank of ○○ is hereby conferred upon the person named above.

Date of conferment: ______ Year ______ Month ______ Day

President of the Republic of Korea
[Official seal]

Printed form size: 210 mm × 297 mm.
Paper specification in the supplied source: White bond paper, 120 g/m² or white bond paper, 80 g/m².

All legible certificate fields, legal authority, rank placeholder, date, issuing authority, official-seal box and paper measurements are reproduced. The original Korean printing specification has unmatched parentheses, and the exact graphic placement of its framed certificate requires inspection of the original attachment.
